code='''def transform(grid):
    # A uniform separator divides two same-sized panels. Mark cells that
    # contain the same value in both panels; use 3 for matches and the
    # repeated shared panel color for non-matches.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    total = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    sr = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and total[row[0]] == w), None)
    sc = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and total[grid[0][c]] == h), None)
    if sr is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sr], grid[sr+1:]
        # panels are equal-sized; use the two sections adjacent to divider
        n = min(len(a), len(b))
        a, b = a[-n:], b[:n]
    elif sc is not None:
        a = [row[:sc] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sc+1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
        a = [row[-n:] for row in a]; b = [row[:n] for row in b]
    else:
        return grid
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    # Background is the common value with greatest combined frequency.
    freq = Counter(v for row in a for v in row) + Counter(v for row in b for v in row)
    bg = max(common, key=lambda v: freq[v])
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else bg for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
print(os.path.getsize(p))
